subject: Ask: 5-day 'warm' grant while PO moves through Treasury
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Sharma <anita@medique.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Ask: 5-day 'warm' grant while PO moves through Treasury

Hi Anita —

Thanks again for walking us through the security review on Friday. I understand your procurement team has kicked this to Treasury for an additional verification step; that can sometimes add 4–7 business days. We'd hate for your engineering team to lose momentum.

Would Medique be open to a short, one-time 5-day sandbox/top-up grant (no billing changes) so your devs can keep the integration and eval work running while the PO clears? If yes, we can provision a capped token allowance and attach a short addendum that keeps everything auditable.

Quick details we suggest:
- Duration: 5 calendar days starting when you confirm
- Cap: 250k tokens (estimate based on the demo workload we discussed)
- Conditions: One-time, non-renewing; requires a summary email from procurement when PO is approved

If that works, I can loop in our finance lead for approval today and get you a token pack by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: procurement-timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Anita Sharma <anita@medique.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ask: 5-day 'warm' grant while PO moves through Treasury

On Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 10:05 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Would Medique be open to a short, one-time 5-day sandbox/top-up grant...

Hi Dylan —

Really appreciate the offer. Procurement pushed the PO up for an internal audit (we had a vendor checklist flag) and Treasury is taking another look. My engineering lead is blocked on a validation task that needs the sandbox to complete a final pass — if we lose access we risk slipping the pilot by two weeks.

5 days sounds good to me. Can you confirm the exact token cap and whether there will be any billing events triggered if we hit the cap? We need a written trace for our auditors (simple PDF note confirming one-time credit will be applied and that it won't auto-convert to a paid invoice).

If you can provide the PDF and a brief set of instructions for how our team redeems the tokens, I'll escalate to procurement and ask them to reply with an approval summary when the PO clears.

—Anita
Anita Sharma
Head of Platform Partnerships, Medique Health
anita@medique.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Ask: 5-day 'warm' grant while PO moves through Treasury

Ben / Monica —

Forwarding a request from Medique (DEAL-8594). Summary: procurement has a short Treasury audit; customer asked for a one-time 5-day sandbox/top-up to keep their pilot running. Proposed terms (customer approved in thread):
- 5 days starting on customer confirmation
- 250k tokens cap
- Non-billing, non-renewing, one-time credit; must receive a procurement status email when PO is approved

Business impact: keeps pilot momentum and avoids a ~2-week slip; likely ~$450 of usage exposure if they hit cap (we expect lower).

Can Finance approve a one-time application of the credit and produce a short PDF confirmation for Medique auditors? If approved, please send the PDF and a token-redeem instruction stub and I'll deliver to Anita.

Thanks —
Dylan

Approve the one-time 5-day grant. Monica — can you apply a temporary credit (250k token equivalent) to the Medique sandbox account and generate a brief confirmation PDF that states: one-time credit applied, non-billable, expires after 5 days, will not convert to an invoice? CC Dylan and Anita on the confirmation.

Grace — please coordinate so we can add a short note to the customer record in HubSpot and flag in support if they exceed cap.

Ben

Hi Anita / Dylan —

This is Monica from Finance. As approved, I applied a one-time sandbox credit to Medique's account today. Details: 
- Credit: 250,000 tokens equivalent (capped)
- Active: 2026-12-02 16:20 PST through 2026-12-07 16:20 PST (5 calendar days)
- Billing: Non-billable; will not convert to invoice if cap reached; finance will reconcile against PO once Treasury completes the audit

Attached: temporary-credit-approval.pdf (approval stub, signed), warm-grant-instructions.txt (redeem instructions).
